validation: Not run by worker: Main exclusively owns compilation, validation, Unity, installed services, provider operations and actual visual review.

installation.timing: Main copies only after the currently running player build exits. Do not use a sibling project.

launch.visualReview: python3 artifacts/studio/verification/TOOLS/P42hMedia/review.py --out $GAMECORE_P42H_OUT --decision PASS --reviewer Main --observation 'Exact actually observed portrait or before/applied/undone robe pixels'
launch.order: Use one fresh absolute GAMECORE_P42H_OUT for portrait and another for robe. Export GAMECORE_P42H_OUT so the child Editor receives it. Start the read-only ledger observer through hub alongside each single serial Unity launch. Never relaunch a paid mode into a new output directory to bypass an uncertain attempt. Once both calls are issued the packet image budget is exhausted.
launch.runtimeExit: Unity and observer exit 0 when runtime assertions pass. result.json intentionally remains BLOCKED with runtimeStatus PASS until Main actually reviews the named images and invokes review.py. Technical success cannot silently substitute for visual green-robe/portrait acceptance.

paidAuthority.productionPath: EtosMediaGenerator.GenerateImageAsync -> current StudioUiSession.Context.Gateway -> authenticated companion -> retained verified artifact -> normal Engine asset.import
paidAuthority.changeSetId: Omitted on the paid request. IDs minted for local journal imports/manual engine assignment are not supplied as request authority.
paidAuthority.workerRequestIds: None: this direct-media app-owned workflow does not submit a worker request or task. Real effectKey/jobId/etosRef are retained from companion artifacts.producer.
paidAuthority.retries: No harness repeat generation. The production gateway may look up its identical idempotency key during its existing bounded replay window.

dependencies: Installed-current paired companion, root games/hollowmere registration and verified positive image tariff <= USD0.20; preserve all ceilings.
Graphical DISPLAY=:1 with working actual Studio window pixel capture.
Read-only companion ledger path: ~/.local/share/etos-studio/agents/gamecore-studio/state/ledger.db, override via ledger.py --ledger only if Main's installed path differs.
No concurrent paid media during either observed interval; any unrelated ledger charge intentionally blocks isolation.
Robe requires existing Maren in ThornwickVillage, entity.setMaterialTexture in catalog, real Body renderer with one slot and _BaseMap Texture2D property.

Robe performs real world bake, then Boot/New Game and production view observation for before/applied/undone. Reload-safe state is in SessionState and ScriptableSingleton. A paid Task lost to an unexpected reload blocks rather than resubmits.
Harness source references existing P2_1 UnityWindowCapture; no new product package or service change.

mainMustRetain: Every ledger-*.json, generate.json, request.json, result.json, raw engine journals, normal History result files and visual-review.json.
One new image media_charges entry versus baseline, immutable pre-existing charge entries, quantity exactly 1, image tariff positive and <= USD0.20.

artifacts.producer key equals sole new charge key; real generate.image etosRef is present. jobId is retained verbatim and may be null on a synchronous operation; producer and artifact changeSetId are null; no fabricated worker task IDs.

Charge ledger digest and artifact producer identity identical at generated/undo/redo/final; original node generation response state succeeded and usage retained. Node may report cost_usd=0 while bound companion tariff is positive; never report that as free generation.
Main's already-retained global packet baseline/final ledger must show at most the two expected new image keys and sum <= USD0.40 across both runs.

Companion ledger establishes charged usage and number of idempotent media operations. No upstream provider invoice or a later separately queried node usage value is inferred. A synchronous operation may expose only effectKey/etosRef, with jobId null; never regenerate to obtain a job identifier.

W-EDIT-03: Exactly one fresh production generation call, no source image reuse, no resizing: providerSha256 == retainedArtifactSha256 == applied PNG SHA256.
Production media service's Engine apply leaves an Applied journal and an imported Texture2D.
Normal StudioHistoryWindow.View.Undo removes the imported file but CAS bytes still read and hash correctly.
Normal StudioHistoryWindow.View.Redo restores an imported Texture2D whose bytes equal the provider artifact exactly; no GenerateImageAsync invocation is added.
Ledger-generated/undone/redone/final are identical for charged usage and image job identity; normal cleanup undo removes the imported file without deleting CAS.
Main sees a real portrait and identical applied/redone image, plus real normal History captures.
W-AI-01: Existing healer selected through production AuthoringRef before generation; no AI candidate repair or replacement fixture.
One real green cloth image is imported, then a separate explicit manual engine operation entity.setMaterialTexture assigns its typed Texture2D AuthoringRef to the healer Body renderer material slot.
Entity presentation content stamp changes; structural recipe stamp stays identical; NPC/behaviour/dialogue/village source bytes stay unchanged versus the pre-generation already-baked baseline.
Actual Hollowmere GameBoot/New Game production World.Views registry supplies the healer view; its Body slot's effective _BaseMap and MaterialPropertyBlock texture equal the generated image asset.
Shared material asset bytes stay unchanged, per production property-block semantics. NPC runtime profile, route, schedule and dialogue inputs match before/applied/undone.
Normal History undo restores the original authored materialBindings/content stamp; subsequent actual Boot/New Game view restores the original effective texture.

Main reviews before/applied/undone graphical captures, verifies visible green cloth on the real healer body and visible restoration. A non-green output, invisible effect or unreadable capture is FAIL/BLOCKED, not a passed texture-reference assertion.

refusalBehavior: Missing seams/provider/import/ledger/capture prerequisites report BLOCKED; contract failures report FAIL. No fallback media, direct SetMaterialTexture call, forced undo, unregistered ID or changed candidate bytes. Runtime-only completion remains BLOCKED pending actual visual review.
